summary.text: John Lively is a Democratic member of the Oregon House of Representatives for House District 7, which his legislative page associates with Springfield.
He says he has served in the state legislature since 2013, and he chairs the Climate, Energy and Environment Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lively was born in La Grande, lived in Wallowa until his junior year of high school, and then moved with his family to Springfield, according to his biography.
He graduated from Thurston High School, Lane Community College and the University of Oregon, with his college education interrupted by four years in the Army Security Agency during the Vietnam War.
His career included serving as mayor of Springfield, many years in economic development, and work for manufacturing companies and in contact center management.
His volunteer service includes the Lane Workforce Partnership, United Way and the Western Rivers Girl Scout Council.
Besides chairing the Climate, Energy and Environment Committee, he serves on the Economic Development, Small Business and Trade Committee and the Higher Education Committee.
He and his wife, Tresa, have two daughters and four grandchildren.
